purpose: Describe repeatedly doing one thing to the exclusion of others.
keywords: Verb て-form + ばかりいる
My younger brother does little but play games.
If I do nothing but sleep on days off, my body feels sluggish.
formation: Verb て-form + ばかりいる
restrictions: Often implies an unbalanced habit, rather than a single continuous action.
mistake: 寝てばかりいる means does little but sleep, not merely is sleeping now.
